text.content: The system prompt review framework

rich_text.plain_text: The system prompt review framework

text.content: Before diagnosing your test results, apply the following four-question framework to your current system prompt. Read each instruction against each question and flag any instruction that cannot answer all four clearly.

rich_text.plain_text: Before diagnosing your test results, apply the following four-question framework to your current system prompt. Read each instruction against each question and flag any instruction that cannot answer all four clearly.

text.content: Question 1: Is the scope explicit?

rich_text.plain_text: Question 1: Is the scope explicit?

text.content: Does the instruction specify exactly what the agent should and should not do in this situation? An instruction that says "answer helpfully" has no explicit scope. An instruction that says "answer using only the content retrieved from the Qdrant knowledge base and do not use general training knowledge" has an explicit scope.

rich_text.plain_text: Does the instruction specify exactly what the agent should and should not do in this situation? An instruction that says "answer helpfully" has no explicit scope. An instruction that says "answer using only the content retrieved from the Qdrant knowledge base and do not use general training knowledge" has an explicit scope.

text.content: Question 2: Is the invocation condition specific?

rich_text.plain_text: Question 2: Is the invocation condition specific?

text.content: Does the instruction specify the exact condition that must be present before the agent takes the described action? For tool descriptions, this means the specific query characteristic that triggers invocation. For system prompt instructions, this means the specific situation the instruction governs.

rich_text.plain_text: Does the instruction specify the exact condition that must be present before the agent takes the described action? For tool descriptions, this means the specific query characteristic that triggers invocation. For system prompt instructions, this means the specific situation the instruction governs.

text.content: Question 3: Is the exclusion stated?

rich_text.plain_text: Question 3: Is the exclusion stated?

text.content: Does the instruction say what the agent should not do as well as what it should do? Instructions that only describe desired behaviour leave the agent to infer what is prohibited. Explicit exclusions remove that inference.

rich_text.plain_text: Does the instruction say what the agent should not do as well as what it should do? Instructions that only describe desired behaviour leave the agent to infer what is prohibited. Explicit exclusions remove that inference.

text.content: Question 4: Is the boundary between instructions clear?

rich_text.plain_text: Question 4: Is the boundary between instructions clear?

text.content: Read all your instructions together. Is there any query that could satisfy two instructions simultaneously? Any vocabulary that appears in more than one instruction's scope? Boundary ambiguity is the most common source of inconsistent behaviour in multi-instruction system prompts.

text.content: Checkpoints

rich_text.plain_text: Checkpoints

text.content: Checkpoint 1: Diagnosing a wrong tool invocation -

rich_text.plain_text: Checkpoint 1: Diagnosing a wrong tool invocation -

text.content: When the agent invokes the wrong tool, the problem is almost always in the invocation condition (What the description says must be true before the tool is called). Read the invocation condition of the tool that was incorrectly selected. Then read the query that triggered it. Find the specific phrase in the query that matched the invocation condition semantically and revise the condition to exclude that match explicitly.

rich_text.plain_text: When the agent invokes the wrong tool, the problem is almost always in the invocation condition (What the description says must be true before the tool is called). Read the invocation condition of the tool that was incorrectly selected. Then read the query that triggered it. Find the specific phrase in the query that matched the invocation condition semantically and revise the condition to exclude that match explicitly.

text.content: Checkpoint 2: Diagnosing a fallback failure -

rich_text.plain_text: Checkpoint 2: Diagnosing a fallback failure -

text.content: When the fallback does not fire for an out-of-domain query, the retrieval scope instruction is usually not prohibitive enough. The model found a plausible response from its training data and the instruction did not explicitly prevent it from using that knowledge. The fix is to make the retrieval scope instruction more restrictive.

text.content: Checkpoint 3: Diagnosing a boundary failure -

rich_text.plain_text: Checkpoint 3: Diagnosing a boundary failure -

text.content: When the agent implies it can perform an account action, the account action boundary instruction is missing an explicit exclusion. The instruction may describe what the agent should do but not what it must not do. Adding a sentence that explicitly states "you cannot make changes to any client account under any circumstances" is usually sufficient to close this gap.

text.content: Checkpoint 4: Regression testing logic -

text.content: Running only the previously failing tests after a revision confirms the fix worked. Running all eight tests after all revisions confirms no new failures were introduced. Both steps are necessary — a targeted fix that resolves one failure while breaking another is not a net improvement.
